name: LA Unorthodox Twistgiving 2025
information: **Please Note: This competition is on a Saturday right after Thanksgiving and this is not a normal competition please refer to the [ Look here for UNOFFICIAL EVENTS!](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LAUnorthodoxTwistgiving2025#60237-look-here-for-unofficial-events) tab or reach out to the organization team for any questions!** - Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LAUnorthodoxTwistgiving2025#59645-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LAUnorthodoxTwistgiving2025#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
